# Parentee

> Parentee is an AI-powered parenting companion app that gives parents warm, personalised, judgment-free guidance for every stage of raising a child — from newborn to teenager.

Parentee is available on iOS. An Android version is coming later in 2025.

## What Parentee does

Parentee learns about each child in your family and tailors every answer to their specific age, temperament, allergies and routine. It is not a generic chatbot. It is designed specifically for the day-to-day reality of parenting.

### Core features

- **Ask Anything**: Natural-language Q&A for any parenting question, answered for your specific child rather than the average child.
- **Morning Briefing**: A daily digest of reminders, school runs, appointments and upcoming tasks — delivered before the day begins.
- **It Remembers**: Allergies, milestones, what worked last week, routines — all stored per child so you never have to repeat context.
- **Meal Planning & Grocery Lists**: Weekly meal suggestions your children will actually eat, converted to a ready-to-shop grocery list in one tap.
- **School & Teacher Emails**: Drafts permission slips, absence notes and parent-teacher messages in your own voice within seconds.
- **Behaviour Coaching**: Evidence-informed strategies for tantrums, meltdowns, sleep resistance, screen time battles and sibling conflicts — tailored to each child's temperament.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Children | Key features |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | Free | 1 child | Basic Q&A, limited questions/month |
| Family | $89/year ($7.42/mo) | Up to 4 | Unlimited Q&A, meal plans, grocery lists, school emails, morning briefing |
| Family+ | $159/year ($13.25/mo) | Up to 6 | Everything in Family + co-parent invite, birthday planner, local activity finder |

All paid plans include a free trial. No credit card required to start.

## Supported ages

Newborn through 17 years old. Advice adapts to the child's developmental stage automatically.

## Languages

Parentee's website and app support: English, Spanish (Español), French (Français), German (Deutsch), Portuguese (Português), Turkish (Türkçe).

## Important notes

- Parentee is **not** a substitute for medical, psychiatric, or paediatric professional advice.
- For any medical, developmental, or mental-health concerns, consult a qualified healthcare provider.
- All family data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
- Parentee does not sell user data or use children's information for AI training.
- GDPR and COPPA compliant.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is Parentee free?**
Yes, there is a free Starter plan for one child with a generous monthly question limit.

**Does Parentee replace a doctor?**
No. Parentee handles everyday parenting questions, routines and decisions. It is not a medical tool.

**What makes it different from ChatGPT or Google?**
Parentee knows your child's name, age, quirks, allergies and history. Every answer is personalised to your family, not the average child.

**Is it available on Android?**
Not yet. iOS only for now. Android is in development.
